positions.title: The Capstone Experience Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Created Pesticide Management for Sustainable Vineyards for the Animal Science department, an application for the management and selection of pesticides for grape growers in the state of Michigan. 
•	Web app for managers (LAMP stack), native apps for Android (Java) and iOS (Swift) for farmhands.
•	Major features include farmhand location tracking, task assignment and tracking, mobile pest reporting, PPE enforcement, weather tracking, pesticide risk calculation, and automatic report generation.
•	Received offer to work as a software developer full-time with the Animal Science department at MSU.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
•	Aided the team during an organizational transition from Waterfall development to Agile development.
•	Utilized React.js, Javascript, and Python for full-stack development of an AWS web application used by health administrators across Michigan and provided leading examples for test-driven development within the company.
•	Received return offer.

positions.title: CSE 335: Software Design - Learning Assistant
positions.description: •	Independently assisted students and graded assignments in an academic environment for MSU’s        CSE 335: Software Design course. Received return offer.

positions.title: ServiceSmarts Online LAM Intern
positions.description:
•	Utilized SSIS, C#, and SQL for the automation of regular tasks performed by the SSO team.
•	Created application utilizing SQL, SSRS, and existing GM dealership data to create automated reports for GM dealership performance in relation to their geographic competition for any dealer in the USA.
•	Worked alongside every member of the department gaining industry knowledge.
•	Received return offer.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
•	Utilized Java, Python, C, C++, and web-based programming languages to develop shared applications for use in the healthcare industry across the state, providing proficiency in the FHIR specification. 
•	Worked with the recruitment team, participating in both recruitment and in-person
interviews with potential candidates, developing professional interpersonal skills under pressure.
